title: The topology of seats
description: Formal shape of `.pkit/capabilities/project-management/project/topology.yaml` (DEC-059 points 1 to 3): the seats a project that runs agents in parallel declares, in its committed configuration, the settings they share, and the pools of workers it may declare (DEC-061 point 1). Every clone reads it from the default branch. A seat's number is its place in `seats`, counted from one, retired seats included. `scripts/_lib/topology.py` reads it and `check-topology` checks it, adding what this schema cannot see: a seat name used twice, more than one organizer seat, a seat with no state issue, a scope naming what the project does not declare, a seat naming a pool the topology does not declare, a seat naming pools where the topology declares none, a planner's seat naming a pool, the `label` ownership substrate, and a seat deleted or moved against the default branch. Code that cannot read the file in full, a key or a value this schema does not hold among it, takes no work, no seat and no release by force (DEC-061 point 9). Companion per COR-018.

binds_to.description: Repo-relative globs matching the adopter-data files this schema validates (COR-023 fallback binding). Present on the kit-shipped binding carrier; absent from adopter data files.

settings.description: The settings the seats share (DEC-059 point 2).

release_mode.description: The mode in which a seat is released (DEC-059 point 5). `tolerant`, the default and the only mode built: a seat stays taken until its clone releases it, or until a release by force.

pools.description: Optional. The pools of workers the topology declares, each by a neutral name that never changes, such as `alpha` (DEC-061 point 1). A person puts a Milestone into a pool by a `Pool: <name>` line in its description, and a seat that builds takes its work only from the open Milestones of the pools it serves. Its presence declares pools, so an empty list leaves every seat that builds with nothing of its own choosing. Absent: every seat takes from the one shared pool (DEC-059 point 7).

seats.description: The seats, in their order. New seats are added at the end, and a seat that leaves stays, marked retired, so no seat's number moves (DEC-059 point 6).

name.description: Unique in the topology, and the identity of the clone that holds the seat. It never changes: renaming a seat retires it and adds a new one.

role.description: A planner slices the work and files it; a worker takes ready work and builds it; a lead plans and builds within its scope.

agent.description: The agent definition the seat's agent follows. Default `project-manager` (DEC-059 point 8).

scope.description: Optional. Narrows the work this seat's agent takes, and reserves nothing (DEC-059 point 7). A Task falls in the scope where it matches each part the scope names.

types.description: Values of the type axis, such as `test` or `docs`.

organizer.description: Whether this is the organizer seat, whose clone may release other seats by force. At most one seat is.

state_issue.description: The number of the seat's state issue, which `pkit pm create-seats` writes on the change that adds the seat (DEC-059 point 3).

retired.description: Whether the seat has left the topology. A retired seat stays in its place and cannot be taken.

pools.description: The pools a seat that builds, a worker or a lead, serves: it takes its work only from their open Milestones (DEC-061 point 5). Each is one the top-level `pools` declares. A planner's seat names none, and a seat that builds and names none takes nothing of its own choosing where the topology declares pools.
